chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim, who said: I heard al-Muharibi reporting from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of God (may God's blessings be upon him and his family) said:
There are three (types of people) — sitting with them deadens the heart: sitting with the scoundrels, conversing with women, and sitting with the wealthy.

key_terms.الأغنياء: The wealthy; those preoccupied with worldly riches in a manner that harms spiritual development
key_terms.الأنذال: Scoundrels, the vile; plural of نَذْل — people of low moral character, contemptible individuals
key_terms.تميت القلب: Deadens/kills the heart; the heart here is the spiritual heart (qalb), the seat of faith and moral consciousness
key_terms.مجالستهم: Sitting/associating with them; from جَلَسَ — the act of keeping company

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about types of company that deaden the heart?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) warns against three types of social company that cause spiritual deadening of the heart. The three are: consorting with vile or morally corrupt people, idle conversation with women (outside of proper context), and frequenting the company of the wealthy (whose preoccupation with worldly affairs corrupts spiritual focus). This teaching reflects the early Islamic concern that one's social environment profoundly shapes one's inner spiritual state — a recurring theme in both Shia and Sunni hadith literature.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Musa Bin Al Qasim who said, 
‘I heard Al-Muhariby report, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
There are three (types of people), sitting with them deadens the heart – sitting with the scoundrel, and speaking with the women, and the sitting with the wealthy’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn al-Qasim who has said the following: “I heard al-Muharibi narrate from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) from his ancestors (a.s.) who has said, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “
Association with three kinds of people deadens the heart (reason): association with the lowly, speaking to women and sitting with the wealthy.”’”
